unit.unitinstructions:
U.S. Presidents by Portrait

This lesson covers 44 presidential portraits, helping you identify each U.S. president represented in the current image set.

  • What you will do: Each card shows a portrait and president number, and you type the full name from memory.
  • Timing: Study and drill screens last about 10 seconds, review screens last about 5 seconds, and correct confirmations flash for about 0.5 seconds.
  • How it works: Immediate feedback helps connect the face, historical period, and name in a single pass.
  • Why it helps: Adaptive scheduling brings back the presidents you confuse and spaces out the ones you already recognize confidently.

Use hairstyle, clothing, age, and portrait style as clues, then begin when you are ready.
